title: URL and URLSearchParams
description: Resolve and validate URLs, safely encode repeated query parameters and reject cross-origin redirects without actually navigating the browser.
objectives: Construct absolute URLs from an explicit base
Use URLSearchParams to encode and read repeated keys
Validate the parsed origin before producing an internal link
Avoid open redirects and manual query-string concatenation
rubric: I verified normalized relative paths and percent encoding.
I rejected external origins after parsing rather than trusting the base argument.
I confirmed repeated query keys without navigating or sending requests.
